title: The Magic Garden
description: NCERT Class 3 English (Marigold): 'The Magic Garden'. New words, comprehension, present tense, and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'The Magic Garden': garden, seed, bloom, water.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'The Magic Garden' mean (garden, seed, bloom, water); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: We plant a ___ to grow a plant.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: When a flower opens, we say it is in ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: She waters the plants every morning.
The seeds grow into bright flowers.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'The Magic Garden' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'The Magic Garden'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In the story, the children look after the ___ together.
In the story, the children grow a garden by planting a ___.

exemplars: She waters the plants every morning.
The seeds grow into bright flowers.

nodes.title: Present Tense
nodes.teach_focus: The present tense tells what happens now or every day. Add -s for he/she/it: she plants, they plant.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses present tense correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of present tense.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Choose the correct present tense: 'She ___ the plants every day.'

bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: She waters the plants every day.
They play in the garden after school.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'The Magic Garden'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'The Magic Garden': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In my garden, I would grow a ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.
A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: She waters the plants every morning.
The seeds grow into bright flowers.

items.prompt: When a flower opens, we say it is in ___.
We plant a ___ to grow a plant.
In the story, the children look after the ___ together.
In the story, the children grow a garden by planting a ___.
Choose the correct present tense: 'She ___ the plants every day.'
